categories.reference-players: Comparable music players and product architecture
categories.engineering: Rust code quality, portability, and security

sources.title: RFC 9639: FLAC
sources.decision: Implement native FLAC frames, metadata, CRC, Rice, fixed and LPC, channel reconstruction.
sources.validation: Decode/CRC tests and IETF corpus; verify PCM against reference.
sources.license_note: IETF standards text; write our own decoder

sources.title: IETF FLAC decoder testbench
sources.decision: Use subset/uncommon/faulty cases, including rejection and hang-resistance.
sources.validation: Run testbench, compare PCM/STREAMINFO MD5 and record pass counts.
sources.license_note: CC0 test corpus; fixture provenance tracked

sources.title: Xiph FLAC reference
sources.decision: Differential oracle only; do not bundle or copy decoder code.
sources.validation: Compare PCM and error behavior with pinned reference version.
sources.license_note: Reference libraries BSD-like; tools GPL; no code reuse

sources.title: Claxon pure Rust FLAC
sources.decision: Study how small a lossless Rust decoder can be; compare performance methodology.
sources.validation: Benchmark decoded samples/s on same hardware with a documented corpus.
sources.license_note: Apache-2.0; architecture only; do not copy

sources.title: Symphonia audio
sources.decision: Feature-controlled decoder comparison; explicitly excluded from runtime.
sources.validation: No Symphonia dependency in cargo metadata or lockfile.
sources.license_note: Open source; design reference, not a dependency

sources.title: Music Player Daemon
sources.decision: Separate codec, music database, control, and physical outputs.
sources.validation: Each module builds without UI or native audio libs.
sources.license_note: GPL project; do not transplant code

sources.title: Termusic
sources.decision: Study keyboard-first playlists and compact status, not dependency surface.
sources.validation: Micro controls tested at small display sizes.

sources.title: Firefly TUI music player
sources.decision: Contrast compact transport controls and library paths.
sources.validation: Compare startup/memory with equivalent local file library.
sources.license_note: Review upstream license; no code reuse

sources.title: Apple ALAC reference and cookie
sources.decision: Design independent ALAC prediction and CAF/MP4 demux; do not link or copy the reference.
sources.validation: Differential ALAC PCM golden vectors and malformed MP4 atoms.

sources.title: Apple AudioQueueNewOutput
sources.decision: Thin native PCM output ABI; decode on worker, not playback callback.
sources.validation: macOS signed PCM format negotiation, device swap and drain tests.
sources.license_note: OS API; adapter code owned by Rust Music

sources.title: Windows WASAPI
sources.decision: Thin Windows audio endpoint adapter with no resampling surprises.
sources.validation: WASAPI shared/exclusive bit-match acceptance on device.

sources.title: WASAPI exclusive streams
sources.decision: Prefer capability negotiation, warn before exclusive device seizure.
sources.validation: Windows format capability and system-audio behavior tests.

sources.title: Android NDK AAudio
sources.decision: Thin Android output ABI for deployable micro player.
sources.validation: Actual Android 26+ format, focus, standby and output tests.

sources.title: MPD ALSA output guidance
sources.decision: Avoid implicit dmix/resample for strict audio; request direct hw device explicitly.
sources.validation: Linux ALSA direct-device format/no-resample field verification.

sources.title: Rust API Guidelines
sources.decision: Typed errors and portable Read-driven decoders with explicit no-panics.
sources.validation: Fmt/clippy/test plus public rustdoc review.

sources.title: Rust cargo features
sources.decision: Keep optional OS backends gated and dependency-free core default.
sources.validation: Cargo tree and MSRV target matrices.

sources.title: Rust Radio standalone embedding
sources.decision: Reuse module shape: independent lib, explicit Play, host-owned storage and output focus.
sources.validation: Rust Boy adapter can load and unload without second audio stream.

sources.title: Linux ALSA kernel PCM UAPI
sources.decision: Use local Rust ioctl structs against /dev/snd device nodes, not the libasound sound library or a daemon.
sources.validation: 64-bit ABI layout tests plus playback hardware negotiation and underrun testing.
sources.license_note: Linux kernel interface, not a bundled decoder or userspace sound SDK

sources.title: Cargo offline and locked builds
sources.decision: Require offline locked workspace builds with no registry/git packages and no build.rs hooks.
sources.validation: Run the built-in Rust audit and offline build gate from disconnected workstation.
sources.license_note: Rust toolchain itself is an explicit prerequisite; no dependencies are downloaded

sources.title: WavPack 4 and 5 binary file/block format
sources.decision: Use the block header and metadata layout to implement bounded, original WavPack parsing; accept only independently verified lossless profiles.
sources.validation: Header/sub-block bounds, codec rejection, and independent integer PCM parity with missing/corrupt correction-stream cases.
sources.license_note: Format documentation; all decoder code remains original Rust

sources.title: WavPack 5 porting guide
sources.decision: Distinguish legacy-compatible stream 0x407 from the WavPack 5 stream 0x410 when interpreting extended header fields.
sources.validation: Boundary tests keep 0x407 fields 32-bit and parse 0x410 upper bytes; decoder support remains unadmitted.
sources.license_note: Official format guide; all decoder code remains original Rust

sources.title: Winamp desktop player UI and playlists
sources.decision: Keep transport, playlist editing, library and search immediately reachable; adopt keyboard selection and direct playlist actions.
sources.validation: Paired task tests: find track, add to playlist, reorder, initiate playback, return to queue without losing state.
sources.license_note: Behavioral reference only; no skins, assets or source copying

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group ten usability heuristics
sources.decision: Prioritize visible status, consistent controls, recognition over recall and user control.
sources.validation: Measure misclicks, task completion, discoverability and state comprehension.

sources.title: Apple macOS design guidelines
sources.decision: Use resizable navigation, native keyboard conventions, discoverable toolbar/menu actions.
sources.validation: Validate window sizes, keyboard-only tasks and native Mac navigation.

sources.title: Apple progress indicator guidelines
sources.decision: Do not invent track progress; show bounded frame-derived elapsed/total and honest unknown status.
sources.validation: Pause/stop/EOF/frame count and unknown-duration state tests.

sources.title: Apple keyboard guidelines
sources.decision: Preserve macOS standard shortcuts, Full Keyboard Access and explicit focus states.
sources.validation: Keyboard-only library/queue/transport regression checks.

sources.title: Apple accessibility design guidelines
sources.decision: Ensure labeled status, VoiceOver navigation, scalable text and low cognitive burden.
sources.validation: VoiceOver checks, contrast at small text, no time-limited notices.

standards.title: Independent codecs
standards.rule: No runtime decoder deps: do not link FLAC/ALAC, Symphonia, Claxon, FFmpeg, or libFLAC.
standards.acceptance: cargo metadata proves decoder dependency closure is internal only

standards.title: Integer PCM
standards.rule: Preserve integer samples and explicit sample format; do not silently apply floats, DSP, gain or resampling.
standards.acceptance: golden integer PCM bit patterns match source

standards.title: Bounded parsing
standards.rule: Bound metadata, block sizes, allocation, Rice unary and file chunk scanning.
standards.acceptance: malformed and oversize inputs fail with typed errors

standards.title: FLAC CRC
standards.rule: Check frame header CRC8 and full-frame CRC16 before writing PCM.

standards.title: FLAC MD5
standards.rule: Verify decoded PCM STREAMINFO MD5 across the complete file; distinguish zero digest.
standards.acceptance: unit checksum vectors plus full-file reference PCM/MD5 parity on GitHub Actions

standards.title: Explicit audio start
standards.rule: Constructors, metadata scanning and module registration never autoplay or open output devices.
standards.acceptance: player state tests: Ready does not call sink.open

standards.title: Single output focus
standards.rule: Rust Boy coordinates active TV, RADIO and MUSIC audio ownership; one active sink at a time.
standards.acceptance: integration tests demonstrate only one device owner

standards.title: Native output negotiation
standards.rule: Do not label an output bit-perfect until hardware format/rate/channel path is verified.
standards.acceptance: record exact device format and loopback sample comparison

standards.title: No callback allocations
standards.rule: Audio callback is nonblocking, allocation-free, and free of filesystem work.

standards.title: No unexpected IO
standards.rule: Track selection and indexing never trigger network calls or scanning unrelated roots.
standards.acceptance: air-gapped tests and bounded explicit library scan

standards.title: Corpus differential
standards.rule: Test valid/uncommon/faulty FLAC and compare output to pinned reference.
standards.acceptance: corpus report with SHA, exact fixture counts and outcomes

standards.title: Portability
standards.rule: Pure headless core compiles independent of macOS/Windows/Linux/Android OS backends.

standards.title: Machine index
standards.rule: Every source and standard is uniquely identified with evidence and validation gates.

standards.title: ALAC truthfulness
standards.rule: Do not mark ALAC as supported until demux and decoder pass corpus comparison.
standards.acceptance: ALAC source/PCM signed comparison with golden tests

standards.title: Local-only dependency closure
standards.rule: Every Cargo dependency stays inside this workspace; reject crates.io, git, build.rs and undeclared native libraries.
standards.acceptance: cargo run --locked --offline -p rust-music-audit proves manifest, lock and FFI boundaries

standards.title: Direct Linux kernel PCM
standards.rule: Do not link libasound, PulseAudio, JACK or PipeWire; Linux PCM sink must use only a /dev/snd kernel device.
standards.acceptance: Feature-gated native ABI size checks, real PCM device setup and DAC loopback evidence
